note: Adapted from the original English description of Krishna & Emerson 1962 (new species; type locality near Arima, Trinidad, collected by A. M. Adamson no. 1126; Adamson 1940 had earlier recorded its biology and distribution as Glyptotermes sp.); 6 alates and 7 soldiers, the worker was not described in the original. The measurements are translated verbatim from Tables 21 and 22 of the original, in millimetres.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: The alate differs from G. pellucidus in the smaller compound eyes, the shorter and narrower head and pronotum, the oblique rather than straight lateral margins of the pronotum, the 12-segmented antennae and the shorter and narrower forewings; from G. tuberifer in the narrower head and pronotum, the shorter and broader ocelli that are not angled to the compound eyes, the slightly smaller compound eyes, the longer and narrower wings and the shorter tibiae; G. parvoculatus has longer and wider wings, smaller compound eyes, 12—13-segmented antennae and a longer pronotum. The soldier differs from G. angustus and G. perparvus in its larger dimensions in all parts, the wider and deeper median notch of the frons and the more projecting lobes; from G. tuberifer in the shorter and narrower head, the less projecting frontal lobes, the narrower and shallower median frontal notch, and the narrower pronotum with an anterior margin that is not raised and a posterior margin that is less concave in the middle.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head, pronotum and tergites reddish brown, the frons paler; a T-shaped marking in the middle of the pronotum; antennae and legs brownish; wings smoky brown, the scale darker. Head with a few scattered erect setae; pronotal margins and disc with long and short setae. Head longer than wide. Y suture indistinct. Ocelli touching the compound eyes. Antennae 12-segmented, the 2nd segment longer than the 3rd and 4th, the 3rd about equal to the 4th. Pronotum narrower than the head; anterior margin concave; anterior lateral margins rounded, the lateral margins angulate and sloping down behind, meeting the straight posterior margin. Media of the hindwing branching from the radial sector beyond the scale, about 0.60 mm from the suture. Measurements (mm; 6 alates, means in parentheses): head length (to the tip of the labrum) 1.01—1.20 (1.08); head length (to the lateral base of the mandibles) 0.86—0.90 (0.88); head width 0.83—0.94 (0.90); compound eye diameter 0.27—0.28 (0.27); lower eye margin distance 0.11; ocellus length 0.11—0.13 (0.11); pronotal median length 0.45—0.49 (0.47), maximum length 0.53—0.60 (0.54), width 0.79—0.85 (0.82); hind tibia length 0.68; forewing length (from the suture) 5.37—5.44 (5.39), width 1.44—1.56 (1.49).

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head yellowish brown, the frons reddish brown; mandibles dark brown; pronotum as dark as the posterior part of the head; antennae yellow; legs and tergites brownish. Head with a few scattered erect setae; pronotal margins and disc with long and short setae; tergites moderately hairy. Head long; the sides parallel, slightly narrower in front; in lateral view the frons nearly vertical (in some specimens angulate and sloping down); frons bilobed, with a deep and narrow median notch. Y suture indistinct. Compound eyes small, oval. Mandibles short and stout, the outer basal margin uneven; left mandible with 3 marginal teeth, the 1st and 2nd small and close together, the 3rd wide at the base; right mandible with 2 marginal teeth, the tip of the 1st marginal tooth 0.23 mm from the apical tooth. Postmentum not strongly constricted in the middle. Antennae 11-segmented, the 3rd segment shorter than the 2nd and 4th. Pronotum slightly narrower than the head; anterior margin concave; posterior lateral margins broadly rounded; posterior margin very shallowly concave in the middle. Femora swollen. Measurements (mm; 7 soldiers, means in parentheses): head length (to the lateral base of the mandibles) 1.28—1.43 (1.34); head width 0.92—1.01 (0.97); head height 0.86—0.96 (0.88); left mandible length 0.68—0.69 (0.68); postmentum greatest width 0.34—0.38 (0.35), least width 0.26—0.30 (0.26), length 0.75—0.83 (0.79); pronotal median length 0.40—0.53 (0.45), maximum length 0.53—0.65 (0.62), width 0.84—0.98 (0.92); hind tibia length 0.60.
